shadcn/ui: https://ui.shadcn.com/llms.txt 15 - Tailwind CSS: https://tailwindcss.com/docs 16 17 ## When to Use This Skill 18 19 Use when: 20 - Building UI with React-based frameworks (Next.js, Vite, Remix, Astro) 21 - CLI-based installation and management 38 39 ### Styling Layer: Tailwind CSS 40 - Utility-first CSS framework 41 - Build-time processing with zero runtime overhead 42 - Mobile-first responsive design 43 - The Fresh Pantry landing page is complete and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Fresh Pantry — Single-Page E-Commerce Landing Site

### Sections Implemented
1. **Header** — Sticky navigation with logo, nav links (Products, Our Stores, Recipes, About Us), and mobile hamburger menu
2. **Hero** — "Discover Everyday Deliciousness" headline with dual CTAs and decorative visual grid
3. **Brand Highlights Banner** — Bold stats (500+ Stores, 4,000+ Products, 80% Private Label, Weekly New Items) on forest green background
4. **Featured Products Carousel** — 8 product cards with left/right arrow navigation, smooth sliding animation, product names, descriptions, and prices
5. **Seasonal Picks** — 4 summer product cards in a responsive grid
6. **Product Categories** — 5 category cards (Snacks & Sweets, Fresh Produce, Frozen Favorites, Beverages, Dairy & Cheese) with hover scale-up + overlay effect
7. **Store Locator** — Zip code input with search button that reveals 3 mock store results with animated entry
8. **Newsletter** — Email signup with confirmation message on submit
9. **Footer** — Full footer with Shop, Company, Help, Follow Us columns plus copyright

### Key Interactions
- **Product carousel** — Left/right arrows slide cards horizontally with smooth easing
- **Category hover** — Cards scale up 5% and show a dark overlay with category name
- **Store search** — Entering a zip code and clicking Search reveals animated store results
- **Newsletter signup** — Email input shows a confirmation message with animation

### Design System
- **Colors:** Forest green (`#2D6A4F`), warm accent orange (`#F4A261`), soft cream (`#FEFAE0`)
- **Typography:** Nunito (headings) + Inter (body)
- **Style:** Warm, playful, modern with rounded corners, generous whitespace, and subtle shadows
- **Responsive:** Mobile-first with Tailwind breakpoints
